thread:
Alex Kim: Incidentbot not paging for PGW right now, seeing 502s from pager-proxy, customers hitting timeouts. Anyone oncall?
Maya Patel: Confirmed, saw alert flood then none delivered. I'm checking the webhook queue.
incidentbot: Delivery failures: 6/6 pages -> pager-proxy 502. Last error: "upstream timeout". Request IDs: [c3a1f, b9d2e]
Alex Kim: Can you paste the last webhook log?
incidentbot: ```
POST /integrations/pager -> 502
{"error":"upstream timeout","upstream_addr":"10.12.5.8:8080","request_id":"c3a1f"}
```
Samir Gupta: Pager-proxy says all healthy, but proxy->pager outbound conn spikes at 99% sockets in TIME_WAIT. Could be connection leak.
Priya Rao: Is there a recent deploy? eng-infra? @Maya any deploys in the last 10m?
Maya Patel: No infra deploys. There was a canary in pager-proxy 7 hours ago. Rollout looks fine.
ops-runbook: Runbook link: https://runbook/redwood/pagerflow-fallback. First action: force-enable manual fallback and ack suppression false.
Alex Kim: I'm enabling manual SMS fallback and notifying customers about potential paging delays.
Samir Gupta: Oncall handoff: Priya, you're up next in 8m. If this persists, escalate to SRE immediately.
Priya Rao: On it. Switching to manual mode now. I'll post a short status to #customer-success once manual pages go out.
Maya Patel: Queue drained after forced conn reset on proxy side, 18 pages retried successfully. Monitoring for 5m. :thumbsup: 
Alex Kim: Customer-impact: a subset of scheduled jobs had delayed alerts for ~4-7m. No data loss, only delayed paging. Notified CS.
Priya Rao: If it reappears, I'll capture tcpdump and /metrics from pager-proxy and open a high-priority ticket.
Samir Gupta: Logging an incident ticket: INC-2026-0421. I'll attach the request IDs and tcpprobe.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Leaving manual fallback engaged while we run a short postmortem. :white_check_mark:
